summary: Confirmed the production Vercel fix by static analysis, Node syntax/export checks, fresh-context module loading, helper behavior tests, and repository-wide binding audits. All 7 regression tests passed; no unbound applyGenerationSurcharges or getSurcharges calls were found.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking maintainability risk: /app/frontend/api/[...path].js is 4,428 lines, so splitting route families into focused modules would reduce future missing-import regressions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Vercel entrypoint imports applyGenerationSurcharges and getSurcharges from ./lib/creditPricing.cjs, and creditPricing.cjs defines/exports both. Fresh require stops earlier on locally uninstalled formidable, which is an allowed unrelated load error and is declared in package.json/yarn.lock; importantly, no applyGenerationSurcharges ReferenceError occurs. Do not use the preview FastAPI API to validate this production-only Vercel path.
rca_of_the_issue: The production failure was caused by calling applyGenerationSurcharges in the Vercel serverless entrypoint without a live binding in that module scope. The current require destructure at lines 118-127 includes applyGenerationSurcharges, resolving the ReferenceError. Global audits found no equivalent missing bindings elsewhere.
